item.description: At the start of the clip, wet grey mortar is already mounds along the right and center sections of a row of red bricks placed on edge. From 1.1s to 2.2s, the mason lifts the pan out of the frame to the upper left and steps his right leg slightly to screen left behind the wall.
item.context_result: The top edge of the visible brick course is covered with heaps of wet grey mortar from left to right.

item.label: Spreading mortar and packing vertical joints with trowel
item.description: At 2.2s, the mason brings his right hand holding a pointed masonry trowel into the frame from the upper left. Between 2.8s and 4.3s, he briefly reaches behind the bricks to the ground to pick up or adjust tool/material, then begins working along the top of the brick course from left to right. From 4.3s to 14.5s, he uses the trowel blade to spread the heaped mortar across the left-side bricks and slice/push mortar downward into the vertical joints between the bricks. From 14.5s to 18.0s, he uses his left hand alongside the trowel to guide and pack mortar into a central vertical joint so it does not spill excessively. From 18.0s to 26.88s, he continues working rightward across the remaining bricks with the trowel, chopping and smoothing the mortar bed and filling vertical gaps until the clip ends mid-action at 26.88s.
item.context_result: The loose heaps of mortar are progressively leveled into a continuous mortar bed along the top of the brick-on-edge course, with vertical joints between the visible bricks packed with mortar; some excess mortar crumbs fall onto the sandy ground in front.
item.camera_framing: Static low-angle close-up; at 25.4s to 26.88s there is a slight downward camera tilt/jostle as the mason works near the right edge of the frame.
item.uncertainty: Because the camera is positioned low in front of the bricks rather than looking down from above, the interior hollow cavities of the rat-trap bond are not directly visible, so it is not possible to visually verify how much mortar falls into the internal cavities versus stays on the bed.
